headline: Proceed with eligible animal PK curves and within-panel PD targets; hold the shared PD index comparison.

MODEL_BASED_ANIMAL_PK.finding: S05/S02 mouse group curves are usable for source-specific fitting. The mouse dose basis and S21 rat time origin need resolution; S22 rabbit timing/count discrepancies limit component assessment. These issues constrain the affected sources while mouse group curves can proceed.
MODEL_BASED_ANIMAL_PK.next_step: Fit eligible curves at their data level; resolve the held timing and dose definitions.

PD_INDEX_COMPARISON.finding: S01 Kp-T/Kp-C/Kp-A remain held: plotted pairs lack verified common response identities and marker doses, and dose ranges conflict with tolerability text. S02 Table 3 lacks paired indices. A shared comparison cannot yet be fitted from these sources.
PD_INDEX_COMPARISON.next_step: Seek original common-record and regimen mapping before fitting a shared comparison.

PD_TARGET_ESTIMATION.finding: S01 within-panel published-simulation pairs are candidates, but target effects and reference definitions need selection; obscured markers cannot support numerical fitting. S02 responses lack paired exposure, and S09 strain allocation remains held. Eligible S01 panels can proceed within their published basis.
PD_TARGET_ESTIMATION.next_step: Define stasis, one-log and two-log effects; assess each eligible panel within its published basis.

later_and_optional: Optional NCA can describe sampled S05/S02 mouse mean peaks; finite AUC and terminal clearance need further inputs. Later PTA needs qualified PK, effect-specific targets and compatible MIC inputs. Neither gates unrelated current work.
